text:
My neighbor recently decided to take security seriously, erecting a bold "Beware of Dog" sign that looked like it belonged on a fortress, not a suburban fence. The irony arrived the very next day when the postman knocked on the door. Out trotted my three-pound furball, a creature whose primary defense mechanism is likely to sneeze loudly if startled by a strong breeze.

The postman looked down, saw the tiny ball of fluff, and deadpanned, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

That comment has clearly stuck in my dog’s craw. He is now on a relentless, albeit adorable, mission to prove the postman wrong. He practices his "growl" (which sounds more like a squeaky toy being stepped on) and attempts to look intimidating by puffing out his chest, which only makes him look like a very small, very fluffy potato. I’m not sure if he’s trying to intimidate the mail carrier or just asking for a treat, but his dedication to the bit is impressive.

State the color of an eggplant.
